# add development env

Describe and reproduce the author's whole development environment, not only the shell: the set of repositories that "productive work" depends on, grouped as

```
- modules
- tools
- services
- templates
- automation
- and projects for goland/phpstorm/etc
```

The dotfiles set up a machine's tooling; this asks for the next layer — which Go modules, CLI tools, services, project templates and automation repositories should be checked out, where, and how the IDE projects are configured — so that a new machine is ready to work on, not merely configured.
